cards.ex: I told him to leave me alone, and he finally got the message.
cards.exUz: Men unga meni tinch qo'yishini aytdim va u nihoyat xabarni oldi.
cards.uzDef: Nimani anglab yetmoq, biror fikrni tushunmoq.

cards.ex: Our business relies heavily on word of mouth referrals.
cards.exUz: Bizning biznesimiz ko'p jihatdan og'zaki tavsiyalarga tayanadi.
cards.uzDef: Reklama emas, odamlarning bir-biriga aytishi orqali tarqaladigan xabar.

cards.ex: The meeting was, to put it mildly, a disaster.
cards.exUz: Uchrashuv, yumshoq aytganda, falokat edi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yumshoqroq qilib tasvirlash.

cards.ex: Let's have a talk and clear the air between us.
cards.exUz: Keling, gaplashib, o'rtamizdagi muammolarni hal qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Tushunmovchiliklarni bartaraf etish, munosabatlarni yaxshilash.

cards.ex: You have to read between the lines to understand what he really means.
cards.exUz: Uning aslida nimani nazarda tutayotganini tushunish uchun satrlar orasini o'qishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Gapning yashirin ma'nosini tushunish, asosiy fikrni ilg'ash.

cards.ex: Drop me a line when you get to London.
cards.exUz: Londonga yetib borgach, menga xabar yozing.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa xabar yozish (odatda, xat yoki elektron pochta orqali).

cards.ex: I think you've got the wrong end of the stick - that's not what I meant at all.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, siz noto'g'ri tushundingiz - men umuman bunday demoqchi emasdim.
cards.uzDef: Nimani noto'g'ri tushunish, xato fikrga kelish.

cards.ex: Stop beating around the bush and tell me what you really think.
cards.exUz: Aylanma gapirishni bas qiling va menga aslida nima o'ylayotganingizni ayting.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri gapirmasdan, mavzuni chetlab o'tish.

cards.ex: Communication is a two-way street; you need to listen as well as talk.
cards.exUz: Aloqa - bu ikki tomonlama harakat; siz gapirish bilan birga tinglashingiz ham kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zaro munosabatlar yoki aloqa, ikki tomon ham foyda olishi kerak.

cards.ex: Let's touch base next week to discuss the project further.
cards.exUz: Loyihani keyinroq muhokama qilish uchun keyingi hafta bog'lanaylik.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa vaqt ichida biror kishi bilan gaplashish, yangiliklarni bilish yoki kelishuvga erishish.

cards.ex: We always end up talking shop, even when we're out for dinner.
cards.exUz: Biz doimo ish haqida gaplashamiz, hatto kechki ovqatga chiqqanimizda ham.
cards.uzDef: Ish yoki kasbiy mavzular haqida suhbatlashish (odatda, ishdan tashqari vaqtda).

cards.ex: I tried to get my point across, but nobody seemed to understand.
cards.exUz: Men fikrimni tushuntirishga harakat qildim, lekin hech kim tushunmadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror fikrni tushunarli qilib yetkazish, boshqalarga anglatish.

cards.ex: In a nutshell, the project was a complete failure.
cards.exUz: Qisqasi, loyiha to'liq muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa va aniq tarzda ifodalash, asosiy ma'noni aytib berish.

cards.ex: The evidence was based on hearsay and couldn't be used in court.
cards.exUz: Dalillar mish-mishlarga asoslangan edi va sudda ishlatib bo'lmadi.
cards.uzDef: Tasdiqlanmagan xabar, odamlardan eshitilgan gaplar.

cards.ex: For the record, I was against the idea from the start.
cards.exUz: Yozib qo'yish uchun, men boshidan bu fikrga qarshi edim.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy ravishda e'lon qilish, qayd etish uchun aytish.

cards.ex: We're always on the same wavelength; it makes working together easy.
cards.exUz: Biz har doim bir xil fikrdamiz; bu birga ishlashni osonlashtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrlash, o'zaro kelishuvga erishish, bir-birini yaxshi tushunish.

cards.ex: Do I need to spell it out for you? You're fired!
cards.exUz: Sizga harflab aytib berishim kerakmi? Siz ishdan bo'shatildingiz!
cards.uzDef: Batafsil tushuntirish, aniq qilib aytib berish.

cards.ex: The new communication system is state-of-the-art.
cards.exUz: Yangi aloqa tizimi eng zamonaviy hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Eng so'nggi texnologiyalar bilan jihozlangan, zamonaviy.

cards.ex: Speaking of vacations, where are you planning to go this year?
cards.exUz: Ta'tillar haqida gapiradigan bo'lsak, bu yil qayerga borishni rejalashtiryapsiz?
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida gapirayotganda, o'sha mavzuga o'tish.

cards.ex: I came across this interesting article about communication styles.
cards.exUz: Men aloqa uslublari haqida ushbu qiziqarli maqolaga duch keldim.
cards.uzDef: Tasodifan topib olmoq yoki uchrashmoq.

cards.ex: To put it another way, we need to improve our communication skills.
cards.exUz: Boshqacha aytganda, biz aloqa mahoratimizni yaxshilashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xuddi shu fikrni boshqa so'zlar bilan ifodalash.

cards.ex: I heard on the grapevine that the company is planning layoffs.
cards.exUz: Men mish-mishga ko'ra, kompaniya ishdan bo'shatishni rejalashtirayotganini eshitdim.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy bo'lmagan manbalardan, odamlardan eshitilgan xabar.

cards.ex: To be frank, I don't think your idea is very good.
cards.exUz: Ochig'ini aytsam, men sizning g'oyangiz juda yaxshi deb o'ylamayman.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq va to'g'ri gapirish, haqiqatni aytish.

cards.ex: Can you explain that in plain English, please?
cards.exUz: Iltimos, buni sodda tilda tushuntira olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Oddiy, tushunarli tilda gapirish, murakkab so'zlardan foydalanmaslik.

cards.ex: I had to get it off my chest; I couldn't keep it in any longer.
cards.exUz: Men buni aytishim kerak edi; men buni boshqa yashira olmadim.
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ularini aytib berish, yengillashish.

cards.ex: Please keep me posted on the progress of the project.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, loyihaning borishi haqida meni xabardor qilib turing.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishini doimiy ravishda yangiliklardan xabardor qilib turish.

cards.ex: I heard you loud and clear; I understand what you want.
cards.exUz: Men sizni aniq va ravshan eshitdim; sizning nimani xohlayotganingizni tushunaman.
cards.uzDef: Oson tushuniladigan, aniq va ravshan tarzda aytilgan.

cards.ex: After the argument, they weren't on speaking terms for weeks.
cards.exUz: Janjaldan keyin ular bir necha hafta gaplashadigan holatda emas edi.
cards.uzDef: Munosabatlari yaxshi, gaplashadigan darajada bo'lish.

cards.ex: I was at a loss for words when I heard the news.
cards.exUz: Men xabarni eshitganimda so'z topolmay qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir tufayli gapirishga so'z topolmaslik, hayratdan qotib qolish.

cards.ex: He talks so much; you can't get a word in edgewise.
cards.exUz: U juda ko'p gapiradi; siz bir so'z ham ayta olmaysiz.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalar gaplashayotganda o'z fikrini aytishga imkon topa olmaslik.
